newsitem.title: USA: LILCO says storm hit 176,000 NY customers.
newsitem.headline: LILCO says storm hit 176,000 NY customers.

text.p: Long Island Lighting Co (LILCO) said Monday a weekend storm disrupted electric service to 176,000 customers, but only 3,400 were still without power this morning.
"We expected them to be back up this evening," said a LILCO spokeswoman, referring to the remaining consumers without electricity.
Gusts and torrential rain uprooted trees and knocked down overhead power lines, the spokeswoman said.
The utility's generating facilities and major high-voltage transmission lines in Nassau and Suffolk Counties were unharmed by the so called "nor'easter," she added.
LILCO delivers electricity to one million customers on Long Island.
